briefing.headline: Apollo 1's cabin had 5.44× Earth's O₂ partial pressure; no PSI solid test came within 77.8 points of its O₂.

sentences.text: No PSI test-level data exists for the Solid phase in this region, so this briefing is extrapolation.
Apollo 1's cabin O₂ partial pressure was 16.7 psi, which is 5.44× the Earth sea-level reference.
The highest measured O₂ in solid-phase tests is 22.2 %, leaving a 77.8 percentage point gap to the query.
All 263 solid-phase tests are restricted to an O₂ range between 13.6 % and 22.2 %.
Material contrasts at 22.1 % O₂ show that PMMA burned, while silicone self-extinguished under identical conditions.
SAFFIRE data indicates that 63.6 % of solid samples burned at 18–25 % O₂.

gaps: No solid-phase tests exist above 22.2 % O₂.

confidence.reason: The query conditions are significantly outside the range of all available solid-phase test data.
